theme: CS4-2 string literal inside an interpolation slot
text: LEXER/PARSER (all engines): a string literal may sit inside an interpolation slot after an operator or opener ("hi {name + "!"}", "{str_join(xs, ", ")}"), as grammar 6.12 states; a slot that starts with a quote lexes as before. A string read this way is a SlotStr token only expressions accept; a match pattern made of one is E0000 with help instead of silently re-reading the arms after it (patswallow, the one refusal of a running program, listed in the spec). The W0007/W0008 scanners and fmt's comment check skip slot strings. The 712 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes before and after.
